name: websmith-page
description: Static showcase page for the websmith-toolkit

scripts.build: tsx scripts/build-manifest.ts && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build
scripts.check: tsx scripts/build-manifest.ts --check && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && eslint . && tsx scripts/check-repo.ts && node scripts/contrast.mjs && tsx scripts/check-licenses.ts && tsx scripts/test-migrate.ts && tsx scripts/test-setup-link.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && tsx scripts/check-dist.ts && playwright test
